messages:
Nora (marketing): Heads up: noticed ~25 unassigned HubSpot leads since 08:42 UTC. They lack the enrichment flag `enriched=true`. Looks like webhook 502s.
Ethan (revops): Confirming. HS delivery shows enrich-webhook returning 502 for some batched requests. Our RR lambda checks property on first delivery and gives up after 2m.
Jules (ops): Quick mitigation proposal: route leads missing `enriched=true` to `overflow-rr` and set `routed_via=fallback_webhook`, plus extend claim_window from 120s -> 360s via feature flag. Thumbs?
Mei (growth): Thumbs. Also add cohort tag `enrich-web-1765439999` so we can measure lift in owner time.
Omar (sales-eng): Please add visible HS note: "Fallback routed due to enrichment latency" so reps don't duplicate.
leadflow-bot: alert: enrich-webhook /v1/bulk-enrich 5xx rate rose 0.1% -> 8.7% (08:34 - 08:46 UTC).
Jules (ops): Patch command ready: PATCH /feature-flags/leadflow { "claim_window_seconds": 360 } Rolling 5% -> 25% -> 100% if stable. Router rule: if enriched!=true -> route overflow-rr, set props routed_via, enrich_incident.
deploy-bot: feature-flag update queued by jules.ops: ff-enrich-1765439999-canary
Ethan (revops): I'll create dashboard widgets for time_to_owner and first_touch for cohort tag. Alert if avg time_to_owner > 5m.
Jules (ops): Canary started 08:52 UTC. Monitoring: https://grafana/redwood/leadflow
Mei (growth): I'll pause automated webinar nurture sends that rely on enrichment tags.
Jules (ops): Canary healthy at 08:58 UTC, increasing to 50%. Enrich 5xx trending down to 2.1%.
leadflow-bot: note: FF canary applied ff-enrich-1765439999-canary by jules.ops
Nora (marketing): I'll send a one-paragraph FYI to #sales-ops and tag webinar owners.
Jules (ops): 100% rollout 09:04 UTC. Keeping claim_window=360s for 90 minutes then reassess.
Ethan (revops): Incident INC-2026-4867 opened. Postmortem to include retry idempotency and RR dependency on immediate props. I'll own SLA proposal.
Nora (marketing): Thanks team — keep updates here.
